config.fake client: chat.completions.create returns canned replies in order
config.CodeAgent: CodeAgent(tools=[add], model=...) defaults: local executor, verbosity INFO, max_steps 20; 1 step
config.CodeAgent reply: Thought + <code> result = add(2, 3); final_answer(result) (no closing tag)
config.ToolCallingAgent: ToolCallingAgent(tools=[add], model=...) defaults; 2 steps (add, then final_answer)

skips: the HTTP request: openai.OpenAI is replaced by a fake client
remote executors (e2b, docker, modal, blaxel); local executor only
errors and retries: the fake never fails, so no retry, no error step
max-steps fallback (each run ends with a final answer)
parallel tool calls in a thread pool (one call per reply here)
managed agents, images, structured outputs, step callbacks
filter: keep: Python code whose file is under src/smolagents/
drop: files with a directory named tests, test,
site-packages, dist-packages between the root and the file
drop: synthetic frames: lambdas, comprehensions, genexprs,
drop: C functions (only Python 'call' events are seen)
